{{Quote|Oh, dear. Oh, dear me. What would Master Jarstein think?|M-3PO|<ref name="RPG" />}}
'''Jarstein''' was the master of a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with the designation of [[M-3PO (Jarstein)|M-3PO]]. When M-3PO was enlisted by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] to smother a [[Unidentified guard (Roark Garnet)|guard]] with a [[feather boa]] to escape from a [[Prison/Legends|prison]], the droid fretted that Jarstein would not approve of him doing such a thing.<ref name="RPG" />
